prerequisites: Basic concepts from Production Systems courses
Basic concepts from Machines and Mechanisms courses

learning_outcomes.text: Function effectively in a team whose members together provide leadership and create a collaborative and inclusive environment in the organization and coordination of work.
Proactively collaborate in the development of work, establishing goals and meeting objectives.
Identify, formulate and solve complex problems, autonomously, applying the principles of the discipline.
Develop and carry out works and research, practical or experimental, interpreting data and drawing conclusions based on the principles of the discipline.

teaching_methods: Individual and group preparation of essays, problem-solving, projects
Individual study (preparation of readings, exams, exercises, classes)
assessment_rules: The final grade (N_F) is calculated as N_F = 0.30·N_PE + 0.45·N_TAP + 0.25 N_PI, where N_PE is written tests, N_TAP is academic assignments, and N_PI is the integrated project. The course is passed if the final grade is 5 points or higher. Students not participating in the Integrated Project will have its percentage redistributed among the other grading instruments. Students can choose between continuous evaluation or two exams without academic assignments. In the second call, students can recover the written test score, while other scores are respected, and can opt for a single exam or two exams covering all course content.
